articles.title: A Batman Game Trailer That’s Basically a Love Letter to a 90s Song
articles.summary: The new Lego Batman game trailer uses Seal’s “Kiss from a Rose” and it’s amazing. The game mixes 80 years of Batman history into one big adventure. It launches May 22 on PS5, Xbox, and PC.

articles.title: A Giant Hot Blob Under New England Is Slowly Creeping Toward New York City
articles.summary: Scientists found a huge hot blob 124 miles under New England. It’s about 218 miles wide and moving toward New York City at just 12 miles per million years. It might even help lift mountains!

articles.title: This Video Game Has the Grossest First Kiss Scene Ever — and It’s on Purpose
articles.summary: In the game Mixtape, you control two teens’ tongues during an awkward first kiss. The developers added slimy sounds and saliva ropes to make it as cringey as possible. Even they got grossed out making it!
